data.name: Complete Physical Examination

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Complete Physical Exam
data.description: Complete physical examination excluding pelvic, rectal, and breast examinations unless clinically indicated. Includes assessment for TB risk factors and signs/symptoms of active TB including peripheral lymph nodes.

data.name: Symptom-Directed Physical Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Symptom-Directed Physical Exam
data.description: Includes examination of eyes, throat, heart, lungs, abdomen, and visual examination of the skin. Includes assessment for TB risk factors and signs/symptoms of active TB including peripheral lymph nodes.

data.name: Vital Signs Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, minimal

data.label: Vital Signs
data.description: Measurement of pulse rate, blood pressure, respiratory rate, and body temperature.

data.name: 12-Lead Electrocardiogram

code.decode: Electrocardiogram, routine ECG with at least 12 leads

data.label: ECG 12-Lead
data.description: Single, local 12-lead electrocardiogram performed at screening, Week 2, and Week 12 of Study Period 1, and at early discontinuation if prior to Week 12.

data.name: Chest X-Ray

code.decode: Radiologic examination, chest; 2 views

data.label: Chest X-Ray
data.description: Posterior-anterior view chest x-ray and lateral view if needed, performed locally, interpreted and reported by a radiologist or pulmonologist. Used for TB evaluation. A chest CT scan can be used instead.

data.name: Chest CT Scan

code.decode: Computed tomography, thorax; without contrast material

data.label: Chest CT
data.description: Chest computed tomography scan used as an alternative to chest x-ray for TB evaluation within the same time window.

data.name: Dual-Energy X-Ray Absorptiometry Scan

code.decode: Dual-energy X-ray absorptiometry (DXA), bone density study, 1 or more sites

data.label: DXA Scan
data.description: DXA scan performed for bone density assessment. Radiation exposure (effective dose) of approximately 5 μSv or 0.005 mSv. Performed at early discontinuation if during Study Period 1.

data.name: Endoscopy with Biopsy

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Endoscopy with Biopsy
data.description: Endoscopy performed on all participants during screening within 21 days before randomization and at Week 12 of Study Period 1. A second endoscopy is allowed if inadequate preparation or equipment issues. Colonic tissue biopsies obtained for exploratory biomarkers.

data.name: Venipuncture - Hematology

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw - Hematology
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for hematology laboratory analysis.

data.name: Venipuncture - Clinical Chemistry

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw - Clinical Chemistry
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for clinical chemistry laboratory analysis.

data.name: Venipuncture - Coagulation

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Blood Draw - Coagulation
data.description: Collection of venous blood samples for coagulation testing at screening.

data.name: Fasting Lipid Panel

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Lipids (Fasting)
data.description: Fasting blood draw for lipid panel testing at baseline and Week 12 of Study Period 1.

data.name: Serum Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Gonadotropin, chorionic (hCG); quantitative

data.label: Serum Pregnancy Test
data.description: Serum pregnancy test for individuals of childbearing potential (IOCBP) at screening.

data.name: Urine Pregnancy Test

code.decode: Urine pregnancy test, by visual color comparison methods

data.label: Urine Pregnancy Test
data.description: Urine pregnancy test for IOCBP; negative test required prior to dosing at marked visits. In Study Period 1, done on-site only. In Study Period 2, can be done on-site or at home.

data.name: Follicle-Stimulating Hormone Test

code.decode: Follicle stimulating hormone (FSH)

data.label: FSH Test
data.description: Optional blood test to confirm postmenopausal status in individuals assigned female at birth (AFAB).

data.name: Urinalysis

code.decode: Urinalysis, by dip stick or tablet reagent for bilirubin, glucose, hemoglobin, ketones, leukocytes, nitrite, pH, protein, specific gravity, and urobilinogen

data.label: Urinalysis
data.description: Urine sample collection and analysis performed at screening.

data.name: HIV Testing

code.decode: Antibody; HIV-1 and HIV-2, single result

data.label: HIV Test
data.description: HIV testing performed at screening.

data.name: Hepatitis B Virus Screening

code.decode: Infectious agent antigen detection by immunoassay technique, hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)

data.label: HBV Screening
data.description: Hepatitis B virus screening including HBsAg and anti-HBc. If HBsAg is negative and anti-HBc is positive, further testing for HBV DNA is required.

data.name: Hepatitis B Virus DNA Testing

code.decode: Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Hepatitis B virus, quantitative

data.label: HBV DNA Test
data.description: HBV DNA testing for participants who are anti-HBc positive at screening, performed at screening, Week 8 and Week 16 of Study Period 2, and ongoing monitoring visits.

data.name: Hepatitis C Virus Screening

code.decode: Hepatitis C antibody

data.label: HCV Screening
data.description: Hepatitis C virus screening; if HCV Ab test is positive, perform HCV RNA test.

data.name: Tuberculosis Testing

code.decode: Skin test; tuberculosis, intradermal

data.label: TB Test
data.description: Tuberculosis testing at screening. Participants who had a TST (tuberculin skin test/PPD) will return 48 to 72 hours after placement to have results read by a trained medical professional.

data.name: Fecal Calprotectin Testing

code.decode: Calprotectin, fecal

data.label: Fecal Calprotectin
data.description: Stool sample collection and testing for fecal calprotectin at specified visits.

data.name: Clostridium difficile Testing

code.decode: Infectious agent detection by nucleic acid (DNA or RNA); Clostridium difficile, toxin gene(s)

data.label: C. difficile Test
data.description: Stool testing for C. difficile at Week 16 of Study Period 2; additional testing allowed throughout the study at investigator's discretion.

data.name: Stool Culture

code.decode: Culture, bacterial; stool, aerobic, with isolation and presumptive identification of isolates

data.label: Stool Culture
data.description: Stool culture testing at Week 16 of Study Period 2; additional testing allowed throughout the study at investigator's discretion. Other local stool testing (e.g., ova and parasites) allowed at investigator's discretion.

data.name: Pharmacokinetics Blood Sampling

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: PK Blood Sampling
data.description: Collection of blood samples for pharmacokinetic analysis of LY4395089 and mirikizumab.

data.name: Immunogenicity Assessment

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Immunogenicity Blood Sampling
data.description: Collection of blood samples for immunogenicity assessments.

data.name: Genetics Sample Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Genetics Sample
data.description: Blood sample collection for genetics analysis. Can be obtained at or after Visit 2 if country regulations allow.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Blood Collection

code.decode: Collection of venous blood by venipuncture

data.label: Exploratory Biomarker Blood
data.description: Collection of blood samples for exploratory biomarker analysis at specified visits.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Stool Supernatant Collection

code.decode: Sputum, obtaining specimen, aerosol induced technique

data.label: Exploratory Biomarker Stool
data.description: Collection of stool supernatant for exploratory biomarker analysis. Supernatant from the same stool sample used for fecal calprotectin testing.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Colonic Tissue Collection

code.decode: Colonoscopy through stoma; with biopsy, single or multiple

data.label: Exploratory Biomarker Colonic Tissue
data.description: Collection of colonic tissue for exploratory biomarker analysis, obtained from endoscopic biopsy at screening and Week 12 of Study Period 1.

data.name: Mirikizumab Intravenous Infusion

code.decode: Chemotherapy administration, intravenous infusion technique; up to 1 hour, single or initial substance/drug

data.label: Mirikizumab IV Infusion
data.description: Administration of mirikizumab via intravenous infusion at Weeks 0, 4, and 8 of Study Period 1.

data.name: Mirikizumab Subcutaneous Injection

code.decode: Therapeutic, prophylactic, or diagnostic injection; subcutaneous or intramuscular

data.label: Mirikizumab SC Injection
data.description: Administration of mirikizumab via subcutaneous injection in Study Period 2. Initial administration on-site; subsequent doses can be self-administered at home by participant or caregiver after training.

data.name: Oral Administration of LY4395089

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit

data.label: LY4395089 Oral Dosing
data.description: Daily oral administration of LY4395089 6 mg QD by participant at home. Participants should take study intervention at approximately the same time each day.

data.name: Fistula Evaluation

code.decode: Removal of anal seton, other marker

data.label: Fistula Evaluation
data.description: Evaluation for existing perianal fistulas (if present at baseline) and for any newly developed fistulas at specified visits during Study Period 1.

data.name: Crohn's Disease Activity Index Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: CDAI Assessment
data.description: Assessment of Crohn's Disease Activity Index. Patient-reported items recorded daily via eDiary; clinician-reported items recorded at specified site visits.

data.name: Depression and Suicidal Ideation Risk Monitoring

code.decode: Brief emotional/behavioral assessment

data.label: C-SSRS / QIDS-SR16 Assessment
data.description: Monitoring for depression and suicidal ideation and behavior risk using Columbia Suicide-Severity Rating Scale (C-SSRS) and Quick Inventory for Depressive Symptomatology - Self Report 16 items (QIDS-SR16).

data.name: Parathyroid Hormone Testing

code.decode: Parathormone (parathyroid hormone)

data.label: PTH Test
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for parathyroid hormone (PTH) at baseline and Week 12 of Study Period 1, and Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: Serum 25-Hydroxy Vitamin D Testing

code.decode: Vitamin D; 25 hydroxy, includes fraction(s), if performed

data.label: Vitamin D Test
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for serum 25-hydroxy vitamin D at Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: P1NP Testing

code.decode: Unlisted immunology procedure

data.label: P1NP Test
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for procollagen type I N-propeptide (P1NP) at Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: CTX-1 Testing

code.decode: Collagen cross links, any method

data.label: CTX-1 Test
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for C-terminal telopeptide (CTX-1) at Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: Bone-Specific Alkaline Phosphatase Testing

code.decode: Immunoassay for analyte other than antibody or infectious agent antigen, quantitative

data.label: Bone-Specific ALP Test
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for bone-specific alkaline phosphatase (ALP) at Week 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: High-Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein Testing

code.decode: C-reactive protein; high sensitivity (hsCRP)

data.label: hsCRP Test
data.description: Blood sample collection and testing for high-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hsCRP) at Weeks 8, 16, and 40 of Study Period 2.

data.name: Urinary Albumin/Creatinine Ratio Testing

code.decode: Albumin; urine, microalbumin, quantitative

data.label: UACR Test
data.description: Urine collection and testing for urinary albumin/creatinine ratio (UACR).

data.name: Injection/Infusion Site Reaction Monitoring

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: ISR Monitoring
data.description: Monitoring and assessment of injection and infusion site reactions (ISRs) as a safety assessment.

data.name: Hypersensitivity Reaction Assessment

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Hypersensitivity Assessment
data.description: Assessment and monitoring for hypersensitivity reactions including systemic hypersensitivity reactions. Laboratory samples to be obtained at the time of systemic hypersensitivity reaction.

data.name: Bowel Preparation

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit

data.label: Bowel Prep
data.description: Bowel preparation performed prior to endoscopy procedures.

data.name: Electronic Daily Diary Completion

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit

data.label: eDiary
data.description: Daily electronic diary (eDiary) completed by participants for CD assessments including CDAI Stool Frequency, CDAI Abdominal Pain, CDAI General Well-Being, and Bowel Movement Count. Applicable to Study Period 1.

data.name: Height Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Height
data.description: Height measurement performed at screening.

data.name: Weight Measurement

code.decode: Office or other outpatient visit, established patient

data.label: Weight
data.description: Weight measurement performed at multiple visits throughout the study.

data.name: Prefilled Syringe
data.label: PFS - Mirikizumab SC
data.description: Prefilled syringe used for subcutaneous self-administration of mirikizumab by participant or caregiver after appropriate training. Initial administration on-site under supervision of study personnel.

data.name: Electronic Diary Device
data.label: eDiary
data.description: Electronic diary device used by participants for daily recording of CDAI Stool Frequency, CDAI Abdominal Pain, CDAI General Well-Being, and Bowel Movement Count during Study Period 1.

data.name: Interactive Web-Response System
data.label: IWRS
data.description: Interactive web-response system used for visit registration, randomization or assignment to ISA, and randomization to study intervention.

data.name: Stool Collection Kit
data.label: Stool Collection Kit
data.description: Kit dispensed to participants for collection of stool samples for fecal calprotectin testing and exploratory biomarker stool supernatant collection.

data.name: Genetics Sample Retention
data.description: A genetics blood sample is collected at or after Visit 2 if country regulations allow, as described in Appendix 5: Genetics. The protocol references genetics and stored samples sections, indicating specimens are retained for genetic analysis.

data.name: Exploratory Biomarker Samples
data.description: Exploratory biomarker samples including blood, stool supernatant, and colonic tissue are collected and stored at specified visits for future exploratory research as indicated by the stored samples section of the Schedule of Activities.
